name: Lemon Coriander Tofu Soup
ingredients: 150 g firm tofu, cut into small cubes
½ cup chopped coriander, stems and leaves
1 tsp cornflour mixed with 2 tbsp water
steps: Heat the oil and cook ginger, garlic and spring-onion whites for 1 minute.
Add carrot and cabbage and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in the stock and simmer for 6 minutes. Add the tofu and simmer 3 minutes more.
Stir in the cornflour paste and cook for 2 minutes until the broth turns lightly glossy.
Off the heat, add lemon juice, coriander, spring-onion greens, pepper and salt.
note: A light, clear broth with tofu for protein; add the lemon only after taking it off the heat to keep it fresh.
